An important difference between the 2015 JCPOA and the 2026 MOU:

JCPOA was negotiated and signed by foreign ministers in Vienna. Presidents Obama and Rouhani did not sign it.

MOU has involved direct engagement at the highest political level since Iran’s 1979 revolution, including the historic meeting in Islamabad between Vice President Vance and Speaker Ghalibaf. And the document was signed by Presidents Trump and Pezeshkian.

Democrats who oppose the war on Iran should welcome the peace deal.

It may not be a great deal. But the alternative is continuing a devastating war that has already unleashed massive death and destruction across the region and could escalate even further.

Criticize the process. Debate the details. But don’t lose sight of the goal: ending this unnecessary war.
